name: Sika AnchorFix Static Mixers / Nozzles
paste:
SIKA ANCHORFIX® STATIC MIXERS / NOZZLES: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika AnchorFix® Static Mixers / Nozzles, April 2023, Version 02.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/j/sika_anchorfix_staticmixersnozzles.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika AnchorFix® Static Mixers / Nozzles where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.01).
1.2 Product description. Sika AnchorFix® Static Mixers / Nozzles are fixed onto each AnchorFix® product to achieve the correct mixing of the 2-part cartridge anchoring adhesive and application into drilled anchoring holes.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Mixing of resin
    - Application into drill anchoring holes
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika AnchorFix® Static Mixers / Nozzles
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: AnchorFix® resin mixing and application accessory
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 02.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Transparent
2.4 System structure. The following system products must be used:
    - Sika AnchorFix® 1 anchoring adhesive
    - Sika AnchorFix® Static Mixers / Nozzles
2.5 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 5 per bag.
    - Shelf life: Unlimited
    - Storage conditions: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +35 °C. Always refer to packaging.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 02.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application method / tools.
    - Before the Sika AnchorFix® adhesive is applied, screw the correct static mixer nozzle onto each Sika AnchorFix® Cartridge after removing the cartridge cap.
    - It is essential the correct mixing nozzle is used with the Sika AnchorFix® chemical anchoring systems at all times. Use of non-approved mixing nozzles may insufficiently mix the product, vary the consumption and reduce performance.
    - When Sika AnchorFix® Static Mixers / Nozzles has been fixed into position, pump gun at least 2 times until both parts are extruded as one consistant colour. Do not use this material. Release the gun pressure and clean the static mixer opening with a cloth.
    - For Sika AnchorFix® anchoring adhesive installation procedure, refer to the individual Product Data Sheets and any associated further documentation.
4.3 Cleaning of equipment. Once used Sika AnchorFix® Static Mixers / Nozzles cannot be cleaned
4.4 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Do not use other types of static mixer nozzles, only use Sika AnchorFix® static mixer nozzles.
    - Do not cut and reduce length of static mixer nozzle as this will affect the mixing performance.
    - Only use Sika AnchorFix® anchoring adhesives with Sika AnchorFix® Static Mixers / Nozzles.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 02.01) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika AnchorFix® Static Mixers / Nozzles, April 2023, Version 02.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/j/sika_anchorfix_staticmixersnozzles.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety - Regulation (ec) no 1907/2006 - reach. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions.
    - Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product
    - Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
